_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor from SRS's documentation; no upstream egg.
name: SRS
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: SRS is a simple, high-performance live streaming server: publish over RTMP or WebRTC, and watch over HLS, HTTP-FLV or WebRTC. Only the addresses you list may publish, and the HTTP API and console are on only with a password.
startup: { echo 'security {'; echo '    enabled on;'; echo '    allow play all;'; echo '    allow publish 127.0.0.1;'; for a in $(echo "{{PUBLISH_FROM}}" | tr ',' ' '); do echo "    allow publish $a;"; done; echo '}'; } > .raptor-security.conf; [ -n "{{PUBLISH_FROM}}" ] || echo "Publishing is only allowed from the server itself: list your address in Publish from."; export SRS_LISTEN={{SERVER_PORT}} SRS_HTTP_SERVER_LISTEN={{HTTP_PORT}} SRS_RTC_SERVER_LISTEN={{WEBRTC_PORT}} SRS_HTTP_API_LISTEN={{API_PORT}} SRS_QUERY_LATEST_VERSION=off; c="{{PUBLIC_IP}}"; c=${c:-$SERVER_IP}; [ -z "$c" ] || [ "$c" = 0.0.0.0 ] || export SRS_RTC_SERVER_CANDIDATE=$c; if [ -n "{{API_PASSWORD}}" ]; then export SRS_HTTP_API_ENABLED=on SRS_HTTP_API_AUTH_ENABLED=on SRS_HTTP_API_AUTH_USERNAME=admin SRS_HTTP_API_AUTH_PASSWORD="{{API_PASSWORD}}"; else export SRS_HTTP_API_ENABLED=off; fi; exec ./objs/srs -c srs.conf

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SRS release to install, such as 6.0-r3, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Publish from
variables.description: The IP addresses or ranges (such as 203.0.113.7 or 10.0.0.0/8) allowed to publish streams, separated by spaces, or all for anyone. Empty allows only the server itself.

variables.name: HTTP port
variables.description: The web port that serves HLS and HTTP-FLV streams, the players and the console. Add it to the server's ports first.

variables.name: WebRTC port
variables.description: The UDP port WebRTC sends media over. Add it to the server's ports first.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The IP address WebRTC viewers connect to. Empty uses the server's IP address.

variables.name: API port
variables.description: The port of SRS's HTTP API, which the console uses, when it's on. Add it to the server's ports first.

variables.name: API password
variables.description: Turns on the HTTP API and the console, with the username admin and this password. Empty keeps them off.
